==Strengt==
Hello. We have to be careful using "The Wheel of Time Companion" as completely reliable fount about WoT because it has so many mistakes or contradiction to what is reported in the WoT main books... so you are appreciated to add new material to the articles, but please do not delete previous written parts of articles, simply add the new parts and specify that the fount is TWoTC and underline if it is in contradiction to the main books. For example read the entry about the strength of [[Cadsuane]]
--[[User:-kay-|-kay-]] ([[User talk:-kay-|talk]]) 07:37, January 19, 2016 (UTC)

:I understand. I've noticed such contradictions in the book myself, so I'll be careful with any future additions here. [[User:Clockpuncher|Clockpuncher]] ([[User talk:Clockpuncher|talk]]) 02:14, January 22, 2016 (UTC)
